questions.stem: A ball is dropped from rest and falls with acceleration 9.8 m/s². What is its velocity after 3 seconds?
questions.explanation: Using v = u + at: v = 0 + (9.8)(3) = 29.4 m/s. The ball starts from rest (u = 0), so after 3 seconds it reaches 29.4 m/s.

questions.stem: The SUVAT equations only apply when which condition is met?

options.text: The object is moving in a circle
The object is moving very fast

questions.explanation: The SUVAT equations are derived assuming constant (uniform) acceleration. They cannot be used if the acceleration is changing over time.
